arguments.summary: Decision frame: assess NVDA and MU at the closed-market report time across 5/21/63 completed-session horizons, separating issuer operating evidence, explicitly assumed EPS/P-E sensitivities, observed market behavior, macro/policy transmission, and input/commodity channels. All five specialist roles are already assigned; no duplicate assignments are proposed. Final synthesis should compare the stocks only where a common, supported dimension exists and otherwise provide conditional decision boundaries rather than force a ranking.

claims.text: The assessment clock is a closed market, and the latest completed session is 2026-10-02; the available daily prices are completed closes rather than live executable quotes.

The final decision should keep relative preference conditional until Company supplies comparable issuer-specific earnings/multiple sensitivities and the specialist work reconciles macro, technical, policy, and commodities mechanisms; raw price momentum alone is not a sufficient cross-stock preference basis.

gaps.description: At planning stage, no company scenario grids or completed specialist analyses are yet available. This prevents an assessment or relative preference, but does not invalidate the observed completed-session market data.

assumptions: Use only completed-session observations through 2026-10-02 for the 5/21/63-session market-behavior comparison.
Company will produce one explicitly assumed bear/base/bull EPS-P/E sensitivity grid per issuer, with period and share-basis qualifications.
Macro, Technical, Geopolitics, and Commodities contributions will be treated as mechanisms and conditional risks, not causal proof from proxy price moves.
arguments.counter_thesis: Recent relative performance may already embed optimistic operating and policy assumptions; without comparable valuation sensitivities and exposure quantification, momentum cannot establish that either stock is preferable.

review_conditions.description: Reassess the directional comparison after all five specialist reports and the independent Challenger findings are available; change the view if their sourced evidence invalidates a scenario input, identifies a material unquantified policy/supply dependency, or shows that the two stocks are not comparable on the proposed preference dimension.

shared_exposures.mechanism: Both companies operate in the semiconductor ecosystem and are potentially affected by advanced-computing export-policy changes; the dated rule and issuer disclosures do not, at this planning stage, quantify a common revenue or earnings exposure.
shared_exposures.qualification: Candidate shared exposure only; company-specific applicability, current legal status, and magnitude require Geopolitics and Company review.

agent_report.work_summary: Defined the synthesis decision frame and evidence discipline using the supplied live-time context, completed-session price records, and comparison panel. Confirmed from role status that Company, Macro, Technical, Geopolitics, Commodities, and Challenger work is already assigned, so no duplicate research tasks were proposed.
main_conclusions: Use 2026-10-02 completed closes for horizon comparisons; do not treat the single-venue snapshots as executable live quotes.
Require issuer-specific scenario grids before making valuation or relative-preference conclusions.
Reconcile shared export-policy and semiconductor-cycle channels at synthesis, while preserving unknown exposure magnitudes.
agent_report.short_summary: This is a research plan, not a directional call. The final assessment should be conditional and evidence-linked, with no forced NVDA-versus-MU ranking if comparable support is absent.
limitations: No specialist research result or company valuation scenario grid was available in this planning task.
No current consolidated quote is available; market behavior is limited to the dated completed-session data.
